decisions.reason: As a recently launched sensor module with still-unresolved market potential and low apparent cost of remaining listed, it is worth keeping as an option despite only modest website prominence.

Its dedicated product page signals a stronger commercialization effort and strategic fit in industrial electronics, so management would be inclined to preserve the option while uncertainty continues to resolve.
Although only lightly featured and likely facing competitive pressure as a standard module, the cost of keeping it available appears low relative to the value of waiting for clearer evidence.

This kit looks somewhat more peripheral and application-specific than the core module products, but after only one year the option value of staying in the market likely still exceeds the cost of withdrawal.
